newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Munksjo takes up 200 mln DEM 5-yr revolver.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Munksjo takes up 200 mln DEM 5-yr revolver.

text.p: Swedish pulp and paper company Munksjo AB said on Tuesday it was taking up a five year revolving credit facility, led by WestLB and LB Kiel banks.
Munksjo said in a statement the facility carried a margin of 25 basis points above Libor and had a duration of five years.
It said an increase of up to 240 million marks was under discussion.

"The purpose of the transaction, which is Munksjo's first time in the Euromarket, is mainly to finance the acquisition of PWA Dekor (including refinancing PWA's existing loans) through Munksjo AB," Munksjo said.
Munksjo AB's main shareholder is Irish packaging company Jefferson Smurfit Group.
